title: Scenario 3: Connection Pool Direct Hit
summary: Tests retrieval of Postgres connection pool sizing guidance from the database/connection-pool module.

content.overview: User asks about sizing the Postgres connection pool. Claude must load connection-pool/database and cite the 'small number of busy connections' guidance.
content.details: Pass criteria: loads the module and specifically references the advice that a small number of busy connections is better.
content.examples: load_module('connection-pool/database') → answer includes 'small number of busy connections'.
